extension_name: Grammarly: AI Writing Assistant and Grammar Checker App

observed_categories.reason: Full text body, corrections, and edit sessions of documents checked by the user are transmitted to Grammarly APIs for real-time spelling, grammar, and AI assistance.
User access tokens, cookie data, and credentials used to authorize API calls to premium/personal features.
Anonymized or pseudonymous behavioral events, clicks, hover times, writing sessions, and error logs are collected to monitor product usage.
Configurable user preferences such as writing language, dictionary words, and active/inactive sites.

matches.reason: Declared category website_content is supported by actual behavior in the extension.
Declared category user_activity is supported by actual behavior in the extension.

underdeclared.reason: The extension stores and transmits Authentication Tokens (authentication_information) which is NOT declared in the developer's Chrome Web Store privacy practices.

overdeclared.reason: Declared in Chrome Web Store but not explicitly observed inside extension client-side source code analysis.

Personal communications (e.g. emails) is declared on Web Store, which likely references checking email writing fields (e.g., Gmail/Outlook). Within code analysis, this falls under website_content and document content checks.
Location data (IP region coordinates) is declared on the Web Store, but content scripts do not directly access geolocations. Geolocation resolution likely occurs conservatively server-side.

developer_statement_checks.reason: No evidence of third-party user data sales or unauthorized marketing brokers was discovered inside the extension summary files.
Data collected (document text, telemetry, config settings) directly relates to Grammarly core functional capabilities as an interactive writing helper.
No credit scores, lending, or eligibility calculations were identified inside any extension code block.

overall_assessment.summary: Discrepancy detected: The developer underdeclared 'authentication_information' on the Chrome Web Store page, although the extension stores and transmits OAuth2 tokens and session credentials. Other core behaviors (website_content, user_activity) are properly declared.

limitations: Analysis is bound to client-side extension behavior. Server-side data processing and log retentions cannot be fully verified from extension bundle files alone.
